asks: Asks the commission to account for Edmonton-South West's population growth and to keep new boundaries within Edmonton's municipal limits rather than combining urban and rural areas.
Asks that Edmonton-Meadows be kept wholly intact as a community of interest, with any needed trimming taken from the western, older neighbourhoods rather than a 17th Street cut.
Asks that Edmonton-Mill Woods keep its name and current boundaries, with any expansion south of 23rd Avenue if needed.
Asks for closer voter parity for urban Albertans, fewer special districts, use of current population data, and transparency about the partisan effect of boundary changes; no place-specific request.
Asks that Beaumont not be joined to part of Edmonton-Ellerslie but kept with rural Leduc County areas, ideally as a Beaumont-centred riding separate from Leduc.
Asks that Mill Woods be kept together as a community of interest following community league boundaries, possibly adding Minchau, Bisset or Southwood, and not split as the federal map did.
Asks that Calder, Wellington and Athlone move from Edmonton-West Henday to Edmonton-North West, with Summerlea and Glastonbury added to Edmonton-West Henday.
Asks that Sherwood Park's riding boundaries be kept unchanged, or if expanded, extended east and north within Strathcona County rather than into Edmonton, Beaumont or Fort Saskatchewan.
Asks for more distinctive Edmonton riding names (e.g., Edmonton-Heritage Valley, Edmonton-Getty) and to keep the Edmonton-Mill Woods name.
Asks that municipalities be kept intact and that Leduc County not be combined with parts of Edmonton.
Asks for more seats overall, seats placed where population grew, and Medicine Hat as one urban riding or, failing that, divided at the South Saskatchewan River.
Asks that Magrath and Mactaggart, north of the Anthony Henday, move out of Edmonton-South into Edmonton-Whitemud or Edmonton-Rutherford.
Asks that Edmonton-McClung take Jamieson Place, Cameron Heights, Glastonbury, Granville and Patricia Heights from neighbouring ridings and give West Meadowlark to Edmonton-Riverview.
Asks that rural and urban areas be kept in separate ridings and that First Nations and Metis settlements such as Maskwacis and Alexis not be divided among ridings.
Asks that Edmonton-Highlands-Norwood and other mature ridings be left unchanged and that Edmonton and Calgary ridings stay within municipal boundaries.

Asks that the part of Edmonton-South north of the Anthony Henday be removed, that boundaries follow freeways and rivers and keep communities of interest together, and suggests new names such as Edmonton-Blackmud.
no request (notes expected growth near a planned hospital site and LRT in Edmonton-South)
Asks that, if districts cross Edmonton's boundary, the commission weigh clear jurisdictional lines and rural representation first, balance high- and stable-growth areas, and be transparent with data.

quote: Our city limits may be inching ever closer to our surrounding neighbourhoods, like Leduc, Nisku, St. Albert, and Sherwood Park
note: St. Albert named only as an example of a municipality next to Edmonton, in an argument to keep Edmonton ridings inside city limits; says nothing about the St. Albert-Sturgeon arrangement. No EB label precedes the quote; record PDF page range given.
